page.overview:
Who is Aard?

In the wildness, Aard encountered Tal Tarag, Vala's lover who also had his brain transplanted to the body of a White Ape, and the two decided to work together to free their lovers.

Eventually, they met the warlord John Carter who agreed to help them as Taak was planning to infiltrate his kingdom and invade from the inside.

They confronted Taak and his subordinates, but during the fight the Kaldane king was able to take control of Aard and swiftly killed him.
